artifacts.claim: Derived exact-volume evidence for the held-out-geometry prerequisite.

heldout_geometry.rationale: A geometry-only fit/held-out split is frozen with disjoint evaluation cores and without quality or ink selection.

ink_validation.rationale: The frozen baseline sources do not include a spatially disjoint target-specific ink-validation manifest with checkpoint, seed, evaluated-array hashes, and falsification controls.

input_integrity.rationale: The frozen baseline sources do not include a target-specific ZPA report with integrity PASS and source attestation for this exact CT input.

artifacts.claim: Derived exact-volume evidence for the surface-foothold prerequisite.

surface_foothold.rationale: Frozen exact-volume geometry evidence provides at least one proof-candidate surface or mesh foothold.

vc3d_handoff.rationale: The frozen baseline sources do not include a target-specific VC3D load/handoff demonstration for these exact surface or review artifacts.
